items.html: And we shall now explain at length their generalities, although there are many particulars. The limit of her diminution is not less than a single point included of ten, which is the point of her last Malchut, as above; and the limit of her growth is that she will have all her ten Sefirot, and will be with ZA face to face, completely equal, and the two kings will use one crown — which is what the moon complained about, as is known.
